title: After the Tenno Sho (Spring): Bouncing Back

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin is overcome with frustration after failing to leave her mark on the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan, however, fights through the frustration and addresses her fans, making a rousing declaration that reinvigorates not only them but herself as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing this, Ines senses that Mejiro Ryan is on another level from her, and begins to seriously consider the way she engages with her supporters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In part to determine whether she has what it takes to reach Ryan's level, Ines decides to throw herself into training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
